ModMetaData.name: Unlocked Schematics
ModMetaData.author: VitaKaninen
ModMetaData.description:
Research schematics are never generated for a handful of research projects that vanilla hides behind a second unlock step - the Biotech mechtech line, the Odyssey gravtech line, and every Royalty project that needs a techprint.
This mod lets schematics generate for those projects too. The unlock requirement itself is untouched: a pawn can read a schematic and bank research progress toward a gated project, but the project still cannot be completed at the bench until the techprint is applied, a mechanitor joins the colony, or a grav engine is inspected. Progress on a gated project parks just short of 100% and finishes the moment you satisfy the requirement.
Works with modded research too, including techprint-gated projects added by other mods.
Safe to add to an existing save. Removing it mid-save leaves any part-read schematics pointing at projects they can no longer contribute to, so prefer removing it between playthroughs.
